name: Branch
title: The Messianic Branch
summary: Branch (Hebrew: Tsemach) is a prophetic name and a messianic title used in the Old Testament to describe the coming Savior King from David's lineage. The prophets Isaiah, Jeremiah, and Zechariah use this image of a righteous ruler who will grow up as a shoot from Jesse's stump. In Christian tradition, Branch is understood as a prophecy about Jesus Christ.

keyEvents.title: The Branch from Jesse's Stump
keyEvents.description: Isaiah prophesies that a shoot will spring up from Jesse's stump, and a branch from his roots will bear fruit. The Lord's Spirit will rest upon him.

keyEvents.title: The Lord's Branch for Glory and Honor
keyEvents.description: Isaiah speaks of the Lord's Branch becoming a source of beauty and honor for the survivors in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Jeremiah prophesies about a righteous Branch
keyEvents.description: Jeremiah proclaims that the Lord will raise up a righteous Branch for David, a king who shall reign with wisdom and do what is right and just in the land.

keyEvents.title: Zechariah presents the Branch as the Lord's servant
keyEvents.description: The Lord reveals through the prophet Zechariah that he will send his servant the Branch, and that he will build the temple of the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Fulfillment in Jesus Christ
keyEvents.description: The New Testament testifies that Jesus of Nazareth, a descendant of David, is the fulfillment of the prophecies about the Branch – he who is both king and priest forever.

keyEvents.title: The Branch who grew up as a shoot from the roots
keyEvents.description: Isaiah describes the Lord's suffering servant as a tender shoot from dry ground, without form or majesty, yet who bore our sicknesses and sins.
